name: Fine Chemicals Technology
description: This course introduces the world of fine chemicals, focusing on their role in the value-added chemical chain. Students will explore the structure of the fine chemical industry, including custom manufacturing, contract research, and major business dynamics. The course covers both traditional chemical synthesis and biotechnological approaches, along with plant design and operations. Applications in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, fragrances, and electronics are discussed. Emphasis is placed on research and development strategies, project management, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship, preparing students to engage with evolving industry trends and opportunities in high-value, small-volume chemical production.
